title: Keep one guided review deck on the pull request range
preconditions: A pull request fixture has a base, a head, a review deck, slide Items, and exact code links.

steps.action: Open the pull request review deck and inspect its Items and code diff.
steps.expected_result: The deck explains the transition and links each Item to current documentation and exact changed code.

steps.action: Push another commit to the pull request and rebuild review state.
steps.expected_result: The live review follows the current merge-base range and head.

steps.action: Attempt to create a second review deck for the same pull request.
steps.expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and no partial review files are written.

expected_result: Pass when one deck follows the pull request base and head while preserving contextual explanation links; fail on a duplicate deck, stale live range, or missing transition evidence.
